title: Chatbot or Agent Sorter
description: The learner will distinguish chatbot behaviors from personal-agent behaviors by classifying 10 described behaviors, with at least 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt.
creator: Open Study Buddy
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Study Buddy
chapter_title: Personal Agents and the Open Study Buddy Architecture

learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish chatbot behaviors from personal-agent behaviors by classifying 10 described behaviors, with at least 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt.

pedagogical.pattern: Classification quiz with immediate feedback (two bins, ten items)
misconceptionsAddressed: Any program that talks is an agent.
A chatbot that sounds smart is an agent.
An agent must be a robot or a physical device.
pedagogical.assessment: Mastery is 8 of 10 behaviors sorted correctly on the first run.
pedagogical.defaultState: Opens at the first item with nothing answered; there is no animation or timer.

controls.label: Chatbot behavior
controls.purpose: Sort the current behavior into the Chatbot bin (one attempt)

controls.label: Agent behavior
controls.purpose: Sort the current behavior into the Agent bin (one attempt)

controls.label: Next / See results
controls.purpose: Advance after answering; disabled until an answer is given

controls.label: Restart
controls.purpose: Practice run with the same ten behaviors in a new random order
